fact: BRELA's service page sets out a 10-step company registration through its online registration system (ORS), with payment by mobile or bank.
NIDA lists online company and TIN registration among the services delivered through its consent-based eKYC.

BRELA said in a statement that all new applications for company registration, annual returns, information updates and closures are now handled through its upgraded online system, the BRELA Online Service (BOS).

BRELA's public notice of 6 January 2026 says all registered companies must file beneficial owner information through its electronic system at bo.brela.go.tz, and those that have not are barred from transactions with the Registrar.

BRELA reported that by April 2026 it had registered 16,864 companies and 30,631 business names, and its online services let applicants register and carry out post-registration transactions without a physical counter.
